name: Noi Easlen
source:
She is recognized by all as the best magician in Amidahara, and is said to have lived for hundreds of years.
She is from the magical world, but his race is unknown.
She is one of the most important members of the Amidahara Magicians' Guild, which controls the darkness in Amidahara, and never makes enemies with any villain.

She is also known as "Auntie".
She runs a small souvenir shop for tourists called "Magical Hall," where she always sits at the counter like an ornament.
Annerose calls her "grandma" and adores her, but she always treats her like a child and is basically unappreciative.
